prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: registered story-game illustration, one square image. Edit target: the supplied 780 by 780 image of the established cave pressure habitat and its three vegetable beds. Keep the same camera, crop, room outline, sink, faucet, end wall, small left window, right door, irrigation pipes, ceramic bed walls, floor, color and painterly rendering EXACTLY as supplied. Change only what is needed to cover the plants for temporary cold protection.
Add THREE SEPARATE low soft off-white breathable cloth row covers, one over each existing crop bed, each following its own crop height: tallest left potato plants, medium rear-center soybean plants, lowest right lettuce plants. Each cloth is carried by a fine dark synthetic cargo net only a hand-width (5-10 cm) above the existing highest leaves in that bed, not resting heavily on plants. Show simple fine net edge ties leading upward to EXISTING green hab attachment tabs, with the suspended net drooping down close over each crop; no poles, hoops, rigid tent shape, rails, rings or new hardware. Keep the center aisle open and keep the entire room ceiling open above the three independent covers. The cloth edges hang down outside foliage to overlap the original ceramic bed rims, reducing drafts without airtight wrapping. Small loose overlap/fold openings at the front of each cover may reveal a few existing green leaf edges and the fine supporting cargo mesh, but the top leaves remain protected. Covers look like ordinary soft cloth draped low over each bed, not three pointed tents and not a single overhead canopy. Existing soybean trellis remains inside its cloth cover. Preserve exact original bed wall positions and widths; do not enlarge plants or move beds. Do not add foil to the crop covers; packing foil belongs in a separate later wall-screen operation. Keep all other scene pixels and illumination unchanged. No people, labels, text, invented equipment, new furniture or decorative additions. Render a single square 780x780 registered image.

technical_basis.source: Utah State Extension: row covers, modest nighttime warmth and leaf-contact injury
UMass Extension: thermal screens reduce heat loss; foil reduces radiative exchange
Wisconsin Extension: thermal curtain permeability and condensation tradeoffs

bounded_premise: The cave habitat has no direct clear-sky radiation frost. Covers slow cooling while original reserve-powered heating keeps the interruption survivable. A 5–10 cm gap is drawable design guidance, not a validated Mars performance rating.
